connector.name: CatchAll
connector.registryDescription: Web search API: find every relevant event across the open web, not just the top results.
connector.summary: Hosted at catchall-mcp.newscatcherapi.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.newscatcherapi. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
